user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell, markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _apply_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> models.Post:\n    \"\"\"Ask review_gate whether `action` is allowed, then persist its answer.\n\n    review_gate.transition raises ValueError -> 403 (not allowed at all).\n    models.set_post_status raises StatusConflict -> 409 (it *was* allowed\n    against the status we read, but another request changed it first).\n    \"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        new_status = review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n    try:\n        return models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=new_status)\n    except models.StatusConflict as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    user: models.User,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"program\": program,\n        \"error\": error,\n        \"form_title\": title,\n        \"form_body\": body,\n        \"form_topic\": topic,\n        \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n        \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/posts_form.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    posts_with_actions = [\n        (\n            post,\n            [\n                (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                for action in review_gate.available_actions(\n                    post.status, user.role, post.author_id == user.id\n                )\n            ],\n        )\n        for post in posts\n    ]\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Posts\", \"program\": program,\n                     \"posts_with_actions\": posts_with_actions})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/posts_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, user, post=None, program=program)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_post(\n    request: Request,\n    program_id: int = Form(...),\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, user, post=None, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, user, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.create_post(\n            program_id=program_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic, author_id=user.id,\n        )\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, user, post=None, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\n        f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", \"Post created.\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_post_form(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    return _render_form(request, user, post=post, program=program,\n                         title=post.title, body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/edit\")\nasync def update_post(\n    request: Request,\n    post_id: int,\n    title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    body: str = Form(\"\"),\n    topic: str = Form(\"general\"),\n    action: str = Form(\"save\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program = _get_program_or_404(post.program_id)\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _render_form(request, user, post=post, program=program,\n                             title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _render_form(request, user, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=\"Title is required.\", title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    try:\n        models.update_post(post_id, title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        return _render_form(request, user, post=post, program=program,\n                             error=str(exc), title=title, body=body, topic=topic)\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\n        f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\", \"Post saved.\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_post(\n    request: Request, post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Delete post?\", \"post\": post})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/posts_delete.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _authorize_post_write(user, post)\n    program_id = post.program_id\n    models.delete_post(post_id)\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\n        f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program_id}\", \"Post deleted.\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/submit\")\nasync def submit_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"submit\")\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\n        f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", \"Post submitted for review.\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/publish\")\nasync def publish_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"publish\")\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\n        f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", \"Post published.\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/bounce\")\nasync def bounce_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"bounce\")\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\n        f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", \"Post sent back to draft.\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/unpublish\")\nasync def unpublish_post(\n    post_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    post = _get_post_or_404(post_id)\n    _apply_transition(user, post, \"unpublish\")\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\n        f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\", \"Post Ambassador console shell (T08, #9):\n3\tthe \"My posts\" landing screen.\n4\t\n5\tEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\n6\tas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\n7\tredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\n8\trouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\n9\tthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n10\t\n11\tThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\n12\tthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\n13\tPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\n14\tsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n15\t\"\"\"\n16\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n17\t\n18\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n19\tfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse\n20\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n21\t\n22\tfrom app import models, settings\n23\tfrom app.routes.auth import get_current_user, require_admin\n24\tfrom app.routes.public import page_context\n25\tfrom app.services import console_shell, review_gate\n26\t\n27\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n28\t\n29\trouter = APIRouter()\n30\t\n31\tSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n32\tTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n33\t\n34\t\n35\t@router.get(\"/style.css\")\n36\tdef admin_stylesheet() -> PlainTextResponse:\n37\t    \"\"\"The admin console's stylesheet (issue #13) — every admin template\n38\t    links here with a relative, depth-computed href (console_shell.css_path_for),\n39\t    since a literal root-absolute href would fail check_submission.py's scan\n40\t    of every tracked template, live-server-only or not.\"\"\"\n41\t    return PlainTextResponse(console_shell.ADMIN_CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n42\t\n43\t\n44\tdef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n45\t    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n46\t    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n47\t    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n48\t    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n49\t    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n50\t    groups = []\n51\t    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n52\t        rows = []\n53\t        for post in sorted(\n54\t            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n55\t            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n56\t            reverse=True,\n57\t        ):\n58\t            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n59\t            rows.append({\n60\t                \"post\": post,\n61\t                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n62\t                \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n63\t                \"delete_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n64\t                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n65\t                \"actions\": [\n66\t                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action], f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/{action}\")\n67\t                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n68\t                ],\n69\t            })\n70\t        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n71\t\n72\t    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user, sidebar=console_shell.EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n73\t    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n74\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n75\t\n76\t\n77\t@router.get(\"/admin\")\n78\tdef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n79\t    if user is None:\n80\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n81\t            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n82\t            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": None, \"csrf_token\": None,\n83\t             \"css_path\": console_shell.css_path_for(request)},\n84\t        )\n85\t    if user.role != \"admin\":\n86\t        return _my_posts_response(request, user)\n87\t\n88\t    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n89\t    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n90\t    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n91\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)\n92\t\n93\t\n94\t@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n95\tdef dashboard(request: Request, console shell (T07, #8): the live-preview landing screen, Dashboard,\nContent list, Pending queue, and Metrics. Ambassador console shell (T08, #9):\nthe \"My posts\" landing screen.\n\nEvery route but the landing screen is admin-only (require_admin, same gate\nas Pages and Accounts) — an Ambassador gets a 403, an anonymous request is\nredirected to /login. Page hierarchy and Accounts are their own existing\nrouters (app/routes/pages.py, app/routes/accounts.py); this module only adds\nthe sidebar entries that point at them.\n\nThe landing screen (GET /admin) stays open to any logged-in user: Staff see\nthe live preview described below; an Ambassador sees \"My posts\" — their own\nPosts grouped by status, nothing else — which doubles as their entire\nsidebar (plus logout), since every other console route is admin-only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import get_current_user, require_admin\nfrom app.routes.public import page_context\nfrom app.services import console_shell, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nSTATUS_CHOICES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nTYPE_CHOICES = [(\"page\", \"Page\"), (\"post\", \"Post\")]\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef admin_stylesheet() -> PlainTextResponse:\n    \"\"\"The admin console's stylesheet (issue #13) — every admin template\n    links here with a relative, depth-computed href (console_shell.css_path_for),\n    since a literal root-absolute href would fail check_submission.py's scan\n    of every tracked template, live-server-only or not.\"\"\"\n    return PlainTextResponse(console_shell.ADMIN_CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n\ndef _my_posts_response(request: Request, user: models.User):\n    \"\"\"An Ambassador's own Posts, grouped by status — nothing belonging to\n    anyone else. A Post is only editable/deletable while draft (same rule\n    app/routes/posts.py enforces), so edit/delete links only render there;\n    `review_gate.available_actions` supplies the rest (submit, for a draft).\"\"\"\n    own_posts = models.list_posts_by_author(user.id)\n    groups = []\n    for status in STATUS_CHOICES:\n        rows = []\n        for post in sorted(\n            (p for p in own_posts if p.status == status),\n            key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n            reverse=True,\n        ):\n            program = models.get_page_by_id(post.program_id)\n            rows.append({\n                \"post\": post,\n                \"program_title\": program.title if program else \"Unknown program\",\n                \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n                \"delete_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/delete\",\n                \"can_edit\": status == \"draft\",\n                \"actions\": [\n                    (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action], f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/{action}\")\n                    for action in review_gate.available_actions(status, user.role, True)\n                ],\n            })\n        groups.append({\"status\": status, \"rows\": rows})\n\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user, sidebar=console_shell.EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"My posts\", \"groups\": groups})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/my_posts.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    if user is None:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": None, \"csrf_token\": None,\n             \"css_path\": console_shell.css_path_for(request)},\n        )\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        return _my_posts_response(request, user)\n\n    home_page = models.ensure_home_page()\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Admin — Live preview\", \"preview\": page_context(home_page)})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/home.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    posts = models.list_all_posts()\n    status_counts = {status: 0 for status in STATUS_CHOICES}\n    for post in posts:\n        status_counts[post.status] += 1\n\n    level_counts: dict[int, int] = {}\n    for page in models.list_all_pages():\n        level = len(models.list_ancestors(page))\n        level_counts[level] = level_counts.get(level, 0) + 1\n\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Dashboard\",\n        \"status_counts\": [(status, status_counts[status]) for status in STATUS_CHOICES],\n        \"level_counts\": sorted(level_counts.items()),\n        \"active_accounts\": sum(1 for u in models.list_users() if u.active),\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/content\")\ndef content_list(\n    request: Request,\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    status: str = \"\",\n    kind: str = \"\",\n):\n    items = []\n    if kind in (\"\", \"page\"):\n        for page in models.list_all_pages():\n            if status and page.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Page\", \"title\": page.title, \"status\": page.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/pages/{page.id}/edit\",\n            })\n    if kind in (\"\", \"post\"):\n        for post in models.list_all_posts():\n            if status and post.status != status:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"kind\": \"Post\", \"title\": post.title, \"status\": post.status,\n                \"href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n            })\n\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Content list\",\n        \"items\": items,\n        \"status_choices\": STATUS_CHOICES,\n        \"type_choices\": TYPE_CHOICES,\n        \"status_filter\": status,\n        \"kind_filter\": kind,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/content_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pending\")\ndef pending_queue(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    pending = sorted(\n        (p for p in models.list_all_posts() if p.status == \"pending\"),\n        key=lambda p: p.updated_at,\n    )\n    rows = []\n    for post in pending:\n        author = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n        rows.append({\n            \"post\": post,\n            \"author_name\": author.display_name if author else \"Unknown\",\n            \"submitted_date\": (post.updated_at or \"\")[:10],\n            \"edit_href\": f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\",\n        })\n\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Pending queue\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/pending_queue.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/metrics\")\ndef metrics(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    programs = [p for p in models.list_all_pages() if models.is_program_page(p)]\n    rows = sorted(\n        (\n            {\"program\": program, \"count\": len(models.list_posts_by_program(program.id))}\n            for program in programs\n        ),\n        key=lambda row: row[\"program\"].title,\n    )\n\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Metrics\", \"rows\": rows})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/metrics.html\", context)\n","numLines":188,"startLine":1,"totalLines":188}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e8fd64a2-4034-4c9d-a2cc-6e1b764f02f8","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import csrf, passwords\nfrom app.services.css_path import css_path_for\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nGENERIC_LOGIN_ERROR = \"Incorrect email or password.\"\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_user` for an anonymous request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `require_admin` for a non-admin request; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass CsrfInvalid(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `verify_csrf` for a missing or wrong token; caught in app/main.py.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef ensure_csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Make sure the session has a CSRF token, and return it for the form.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = csrf.generate_token()\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    session_token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not csrf.tokens_match(session_token, submitted):\n        raise CsrfInvalid()\n\n\ndef get_current_user(request: Request) -> models.User | None:\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    if user_id is None:\n        return None\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None or not user.active:\n        return None\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_user(request: Request) -> models.User:\n    user = get_current_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired()\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_admin(user: models.User = Depends(require_user)) -> models.User:\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        raise AdminRequired()\n    return user\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": None,\n         \"css_path\": css_path_for(request)},\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\nasync def login_submit(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(...),\n    password: str = Form(...),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    user = models.get_user_by_email(email)\n    if user is None or not user.active or not ensure_csrf_token(request)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Log in\", \"csrf_token\": token, \"error\": request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf.generate_token()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\nasync def logout(request: Request, _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf)):\n    request.session.clear()\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/_stub\")\ndef admin_only_stub(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/stub.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Admin-only stub\", \"user\": user, \"css_path\": )\n","numLines":125,"startLine":1,"totalLines":125}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7c99d27c-8351-4c1e-8187-1d7620bd78f0","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

It and\n5\tthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\n6\tapp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n7\t\n8\tOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n9\t\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\n13\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n14\t\n15\tfrom app import models, settings\n16\tfrom app.publish import CSS\n17\tfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n18\t\n19\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n20\t\n21\trouter = APIRouter()\n22\t\n23\t\n24\tdef resolve(path: str) -> tuple[str, models.Page] | tuple[str, models.Post, models.Page] | None:\n25\t    \"\"\"A Page by its full path, or — one segment further, under a Program —\n26\t    a published Post by slug. Returns None on no match.\"\"\"\n27\t    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n28\t    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n29\t    current = home\n30\t    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):\n31\t        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n32\t        if child is not None:\n33\t            current = child\n34\t            continue\n35\t        if i == len(segments) - 1 and models.is_program_page(current):\n36\t            post = models.get_published_post_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n37\t            if post is not None:\n38\t                return \"post\", post, current\n39\t        return None\n40\t    return \"page\", current\n41\t\n42\t\n43\tdef _path_for(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n44\t    if page.id == home.id:\n45\t        return \"/\"\n46\t    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(page) if p.id != home.id]\n47\t    chain.append(page.slug)\n48\t    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + public site, served live from the database.\n\nThis is the admin console's \"preview\" the Pages ticket asks for: Staff see a\npublished change here immediately, before anyone runs `cms publish`. It and\nthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\napp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n\nOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef resolve(path: str) -> tuple[str, models.Page] | tuple[str, models.Post, models.Page] | None:\n    \"\"\"A Page by its full path, or — one segment further, under a Program —\n    a published Post by slug. Returns None on no match.\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n    current = home\n    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):\n        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n        if child is not None:\n            current = child\n            continue\n        if i == len(segments) - 1 and models.is_program_page(current):\n            post = models.get_published_post_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n            if post is not None:\n                return \"post\", post, current\n        return None\n    return \"page\", current\n\n\ndef _path_for(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"/\"\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(page) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(page.slug)\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n\n\ndef page_context(page: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != page.id]\n    children = models.list_published_children(page.id)\n    active_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n    is_country = models.is_country_page(page)\n\n    post_groups = None\n    if models.is_program_page(page):\n        page_href = _path_for(page, home)\n        posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n        post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n            posts, lambda post: page_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n        )\n\n    intro_md, rest_md = markdown.split_intro(page.body)\n    sections = []\n    if models.is_standalone_page(page):\n        sections = [\n            {\"heading\": heading, \"body_html\": markdown.render(body)}\n            for heading, body in markdown.split_sections(rest_md)\n        ]\n        rest_md = markdown.strip_sections(rest_md)\n\n    return {\n        \"page\": page,\n        \"intro_html\": markdown.render(intro_md),\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(rest_md),\n        \"sections\": sections,\n        \"region\": post_view.region_index(page, home, continents),\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\", \"active\": active_id == home.id}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home), \"active\": active_id == c.id}\n            for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n        \"children\": [\n            post_view.page_card(\n                c, _path_for(c, home), home, continents,\n                stats=post_view.program_stats(c.id) if is_country else None,\n            )\n            for c in children\n        ],\n        \"children_heading\": post_view.children_heading(page, home),\n        \"post_groups\": post_groups,\n    }\n\n\ndef post_context(post: models.Post, program: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(program) if a.id != program.id]\n    program_href = _path_for(program, home)\n    post_href = program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n    summary = post_view.post_summary(post, post_href)\n    active_id = models.nav_root_id(program, home)\n    more_from = [\n        post_view.post_summary(other, program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{other.slug}/\")\n        for other in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n        if other.id != post.id\n    ][:2]\n\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(post.body),\n        \"topic_label\": summary[\"topic_label\"],\n        \"author_name\": summary[\"author_name\"],\n        \"author_role\": summary[\"author_role\"],\n        \"author_initials\": summary[\"author_initials\"],\n        \"published_date\": summary[\"published_date\"],\n        \"region\": post_view.region_index(program, home, continents),\n        \"more_from\": more_from,\n        \"program_href\": program_href,\n        \"program_title\": program.title,\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\", \"active\": active_id == home.id}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home), \"active\": active_id == c.id}\n            for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors]\n        + [{\"title\": program.title, \"href\": program_href}],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{path:path}\")\ndef public_page(request: Request, path: str):\n    resolved = resolve(path)\n    if resolved is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    if resolved[0] == \"post\":\n        _kind, post, program = resolved\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/post.html\",\n            {\"title\": post.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, **post_context(post, program)},\n        )\n\n    _kind, page = resolved\n    if page.status != \"published\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"public/page.html\",\n        {\"title\": page.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, **page_context(page)},\n    )\n","numLines":162,"startLine":1,"totalLines":162}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"aeecfaac-96f2-4de3-adfa-304c7375d1e5","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

return None\n    root_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n    for i, continent in enumerate(continents):\n        if continent.id == root_id:\n            return i % REGION_COUNT\n    return None\n\n\ndef program_stats(program_id: int) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Published-post count and the distinct Topic labels present, for a\n    Program's card on its parent Country's listing.\"\"\"\n    posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    topics: list[str] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    for post in posts:\n        if post.topic not in seen:\n            seen.add(post.topic)\n            topics.append(TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic])\n    return {\"post_count\": len(posts), \"topics\": topics}\n\n\ndef page_card(\n    page: models.Page,\n    href: str,\n    home: models.Page,\n    continents: list[models.Page],\n    stats: dict | None = None,\n) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"A Continent/Country/Program's card on its parent's listing: title,\n    href, a short description teased from the Page's own body, its region\n    accent, and — for a Program card — its post count and Topics.\"\"\"\n    return {\n        \"title\": page.title,\n        \"href\": href,\n        \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(page.body),\n        \"region\": region_index(page, home, continents),\n        \"post_count\": stats[\"post_count\"] if stats else None,\n        \"topics\": stats[\"topics\"] if stats else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef grouped_post_summaries(\n    posts: list[models.Post], href_for: Callable[[models.Post], str]\n) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]:\n    \"\"\"-> [(topic_value, topic_label, [post_summary, ...]), ...], Topics with\n    no published Posts omitted.\"\"\"\n    groups = models.group_posts_by_topic(posts)\n    return [\n        (value, label, [post_summary(post, href_for(post)) for post in group_posts])\n        for value, label, group_posts in groups\n    ]\n","numLines":141,"startLine":1,"totalLines":141}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"67510e00-947b-4f23-ae30-7e1e9517c8fe","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

      <h2 class=\"info-card-title\">{{ item.heading }}</h2>\n              <div class=\"prose prose-tight\">{{ item.body_html | safe }}</div>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n {"parentUuid":"7d0fae0e-582b-4a79-9417-922eb4a07630","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"33a91965-4c86-4d20-b167-647124b02cd2","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01C3HtqNWB4awjpEnJM1YVrX","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n2\t\n3\tT00 (already done): the admin console answers at /admin and the public site\n4\tanswers at /. That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\n5\truns before you build anything on it.\n6\t\n7\tAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\n8\tthem here. Keep this file small.\n9\t\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\n13\tfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\n14\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n15\t\n16\tfrom app import db, settings\n17\tfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, posts, public\n18\tfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, CsrfInvalid, LoginRequired\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n22\t    db.init_db()\n23\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n24\t    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n25\t                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n26\t\n27\t    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n28\t    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n29\t        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n30\t\n31\t    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n32\t    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n33\t        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n34\t\n35\t    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n36\t    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n37\t        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n38\t\n39\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n40\t    app.include_router(pages.router)\n41\t    app.include_router(posts.router)\n42\t    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n43\t    app.include_router(console.router)\n44\t\n45\t    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —\n46\t    # the admin console's \"preview\" of what `cms publish` will later export.\n47\t    app.include_router(public.router)\n48\t    return app\n49\t\n50\t\n51\tapp = create_app()\n52\t"}]},"uuid":"51648d17-fa34-46b9-b36b-84910c39669e","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:45:43.279Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/main.py","content":"\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00 (already done): the admin console answers at /admin and the public site\nanswers at /. That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, posts, public\nfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, CsrfInvalid, LoginRequired\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n\n    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —\n    # the admin console's \"preview\" of what `cms publish` will later export.\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n","numLines":52,"startLine":1,"totalLines":52}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7d0fae0e-582b-4a79-9417-922eb4a07630","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nWalks the Page tree and writes one `index.html` per PUBLISHED page, at the\nnested path implied by its ancestors' slugs (e.g. site/asia/japan/kyoto/),\nplus one `index.html` per PUBLISHED Post, nested one level under its Program\n(e.g. site/asia/japan/kyoto/my-first-week/). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft or pending Post, like a\n     draft Page, reaching site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Kenyon purple plus a warm gold accent; editorial travel-magazine pass, T11.\n   Layout rule this pass enforces: prose always sits in a container (a tinted\n   band, a panel, or a card) and every section announces itself, so no page\n   ends in an unstructured white gap. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --gold: #C98A3B;\n  --gold-dark: #9C6723;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --muted: #5a5064;\n  --card-border: #E4DCEC;\n  --paper: #FDFBFE;\n  --panel: #FFFFFF;\n  --section-gap: 3.5rem;\n  --topic-general: #5B2A86;\n  --topic-housing: #2E7D6B;\n  --topic-meals: #C9573B;\n  --topic-social-life: #B0538B;\n  --topic-academics: #2E6CA8;\n  --topic-other: #6B6356;\n  /* Region accents: one per Continent (cycles if a 7th is added), used for\n     card top-accents and the interior page-header band. */\n  --region-0: #C98A3B; --region-0-tint: #FBF0DF;\n  --region-1: #2E7D6B; --region-1-tint: #E3F3EF;\n  --region-2: #C9573B; --region-2-tint: #FBE9E4;\n  --region-3: #2E6CA8; --region-3-tint: #E4EEF8;\n  --region-4: #B0538B; --region-4-tint: #FAE9F3;\n  --region-5: #6B6356; --region-5-tint: #F1EEE9;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.65 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  padding: 0;\n  min-height: 100vh;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-x: hidden;\n  overflow-wrap: anywhere;\n}\nh1, h2, h3 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; }\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n:focus-visible {\n  outline: 3px solid var(--gold);\n  outline-offset: 2px;\n  border-radius: 2px;\n}\n.wrap {\n  max-width: 72rem;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 1.25rem;\n}\nmain { display: block; {"parentUuid":"b4051ea6-44fd-4c68-bad1-5ba9ca3f7c51","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"33a91965-4c86-4d20-b167-647124b02cd2","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CQrqgVnLLDNXPsYFJwg6CN","type":"tool_result","content":"380\t                \"more printed copies of documents than feels reasonable in 2026.\\n\\n\"\n381\t                \"> Everything you forgot can be bought here. Budget a week of looking for it, \"\n382\t                \"though.\\n\\n\"\n383\t                \"The real advice: pack for the version of yourself who is tired and in a hurry, \"\n384\t                \"not the one making a list on a calm afternoon in Gambier.\"\n385\t            ),\n386\t        },\n387\t        {\n388\t            \"title\": \"Saturday football at the community centre\",\n389\t            \"topic\": \"social-life\",\n390\t            \"author\": 4,\n391\t            \"days_ago\": 36,\n392\t            \"body\": (\n393\t                \"The organisation I am placed with runs a youth football league on Saturdays. \"\n394\t                \"I turned up in week two to take photographs for their newsletter and have not \"\n395\t                \"missed one since.\\n\\n\"\n396\t                \"I am a poor footballer and that has been an advantage. Being visibly bad at \"\n397\t                \"something in front of people is a fast way past the stage where everyone is \"\n398\t                \"polite with you.\\n\\n\"\n399\t                \"## What I actually do there\\n\\n\"\n400\t                \"Mostly logistics: bibs, water, keeping the under-tens from reorganising the \"\n401\t                \"fixtures themselves. Occasionally I referee, which nobody respects and \"\n402\t                \"everybody argues with, exactly as it should be.\\n\\n\"\n403\t                \"> Three months of structured fieldwork taught me less about this neighbourhood \"\n404\t                \"than six Saturdays of being shouted at over a throw-in.\"\n405\t            ),\n406\t        },\n407\t    ],\n408\t    \"Cape Town Semester\": [\n409\t        {\n410\t            \"title\": \"Learning to cook for eight\",\n411\t            \"topic\": \"meals\",\n412\t            \"author\": None,\n413\t            \"days_ago\": 15,\n414\t            \"body\": (\n415\t                \"Our flat share decided in the first week that we would eat together on \"\n416\t                \"weeknights, each of us cooking once. It sounded convivial. It is, and it is \"\n417\t                \"also a logistical education.\\n\\n\"\n418\t                \"## The maths nobody warned me about\\n\\n\"\n419\t                \"Cooking for one is improvisation. Cooking for eight is a plan: what scales, \"\n420\t                \"what does not, how long the one working oven actually takes, who has decided \"\n421\t                \"this month that they do not eat dairy.\\n\\n\"\n422\t                \"My first attempt was a curry that took two hours and fed six of the eight. My \"\n423\t                \"fourth was fine. The learning curve is steep and public.\\n\\n\"\n424\t                \"> Eight people eating badly together beats eight people eating well alone, up \"\n425\t                \"to a point, and we found the point in week three.\\n\\n\"\n426\t                \"We have since instituted a rule that whoever cooks does not wash up, which \"\n427\t                \"has done more for flat harmony than any house meeting.\"\n428\t            ),\n429\t        },\n430\t        {\n431\t            \"title\": \"A flat share, four strangers, one kettle\",\n432\t            \"topic\": \"housing\",\n433\t            \"author\": 0,\n434\t            \"days_ago\": 29,\n435\t            \"body\": (\n436\t                \"The program places you in shared flats with people you have not met. Mine is \"\n437\t                \"two Kenyon students, one from a partner college, and a local student doing \"\n438\t                \"her honours year.\\n\\n\"\n439\t                \"The flat is good: high ceilings, terrible water pressure, a view of the \"\n440\t                \"mountain if you lean. What I did not anticipate is how much of living \"\n441\t                \"together is negotiating infrastructure.\\n\\n\"\n442\t                \"## The kettle problem\\n\\n\"\n443\t                \"There is one kettle, four people who want tea at the same hour, and a power \"\n444\t                \"arrangement that objects when the kettle and the heater run together. All of it is easier to do deliberately than at the \"\n                \"moment you discover you needed it.\"\n            ),\n        },\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Critique day in the studio\",\n            \"topic\": \"academics\",\n            \"author\": 5,\n            \"days_ago\": 21,\n            \"body\": (\n                \"Critique here is slower and more formal than I am used to. Work goes up, \"\n                \"everyone looks at it in silence for a genuinely long time, and then the \"\n                \"discussion starts with description rather than judgement.\\n\\n\"\n                \"## What gets said first\\n\\n\"\n                \"Not whether it works. What is actually there — materials, scale, what the \"\n                \"edges are doing. By the time anyone offers an opinion, the room has agreed on \"\n                \"what it is looking at, which turns out to prevent most of the arguments I am \"\n                \"used to having.\\n\\n\"\n                \"> Describing the work before judging it sounds like a delay. It is the part \"\n                \"that makes the judgement worth hearing.\\n\\n\"\n                \"My first critique was uncomfortable. My second was the most useful hour of \"\n                \"the semester so far.\"\n            ),\n        },\n        {\n            \"title\": \"Six weeks of being slightly lost\",\n            \"topic\": \"general\",\n            \"author\": 4,\n            \"days_ago\": 31,\n            \"body\": (\n                \"I have a good sense of direction at home and none at all here, and I have \"\n                \"stopped treating that as a problem to solve.\\n\\n\"\n                \"The studio is a twenty-minute walk from my flat and I have taken a different \"\n                \"route most days. Some have been considerably longer than twenty minutes. One \"\n                \"involved a canal I did not know existed.\\n\\n\"\n                \"## What being lost is for\\n\\n\"\n                \"Nothing, really, which is the point. The organised parts of this semester are \"\n                \"organised well. The unstructured walking is where the city has stopped being a \"\n                \"set of destinations and started being a place.\\n\\n\"\n                \"> I know four ways to the studio now. Only one of them is efficient and it is \"\n                \"the one I take least.\"\n            ),\n        },\n    ],\n}\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=body,\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, continent_data in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title, continent_data[\"description\"])\n        for country_title, country_data in continent_data[\"countries\"].items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title, country_data[\"description\"])\n            for program_title, program_body in country_data[\"programs\"].items():\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title, program_body))\n\n    for standalone_title, body in STANDALONE_PAGES.items():\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, body, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _ensure_fictional_ambassadors() -> list[models.User]:\n    users = []\n    for name, email in FICTIONAL_AMBASSADORS:\n        user = models.get_user_by_email(email)\n        if user is None:\n            user = models.create_user(\n                email=email, password=FICTIONAL_AMBASSADOR_PASSWORD,\n                role=\"editor\", display_name=name,\n            )\n        users.append(user)\n    return users\n\n\ndef _days_ago(days: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"An ISO timestamp in the shape SQLite writes, `days` back from now.\"\"\"\n    moment = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=days)\n    return moment.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z\")\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The three posts PROGRAM_POSTS defines for each Program. The one\n    with `author: None` belongs to the seeded editor account and cycles\n    through draft/pending/published across the catalog, so the admin side has\n    a Post in every status to work with (T04); the other two are always\n    published, so every Program page has something to show. Each Post is\n    backdated to its own day, so the public site reads like a term's writing\n    rather than eighteen posts filed at once.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    ambassadors = _ensure_fictional_ambassadors()\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        specs = PROGRAM_POSTS.get(program.title)\n        if not specs:\n            continue\n        anchor_status = POST_STATUSES[i % len(POST_STATUSES)]\n        for spec in specs:\n            is_anchor = spec[\"author\"] is None\n            author_id = editor_id if is_anchor else ambassadors[spec[\"author\"]].id\n            status = anchor_status if is_anchor else \"published\"\n            post = models.create_post(\n                program_id=program.id, title=spec[\"title\"], body=spec[\"body\"],\n                topic=spec[\"topic\"], author_id=author_id,\n            )\n            if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n                models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n            if status == \"published\":\n                models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n            models.backdate_post(post.id, _days_ago(spec[\"days_ago\"]))\n\n    total = sum(len(PROGRAM_POSTS.get(p.title, [])) for p in programs)\n    print(f\"Seeded {total} posts across Topics, authors, dates, and statuses \"\n          \"(draft/pending/published) under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef _seed_deactivated_users_with_drafts(programs: list[models.Page]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"T06 acceptance: one already-deactivated Ambassador and one\n    already-deactivated Staff member, each seeded by creating the account\n    active, giving them a draft Post, and then deactivating them — so the\n    cascade actually runs rather than just hard-coding the end state. The\n    Ambassador's draft is deleted by the cascade; the Staff member's is left\n    in place, same as any other Staff member's unfinished work.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not programs:\n        print(\"No programs to seed deactivated-user drafts under, leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n    if models.get_user_by_email(\"deactivated-ambassador@example.test\") is not None:\n        print(\"Deactivated demo users already seeded, leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    program = programs[0]\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"deactivated-ambassador@example.test\", password=\"change-me-deactivated\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Former Ambassador\",\n    )\n    models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"Half-finished post\",\n        body=\"Still drafting — notes to self before writing the real thing.\",\n        topic=\"general\", author_id=ambassador.id,\n    )\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n\n    staff = models.create_user(\n        email=\"deactivated-staff@example.test\", password=\"change-me-deactivated\",\n        role=\"admin\", display_name=\"Former Staff\",\n    )\n    models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"CGE's unfinished draft\",\n        body=\"Still drafting — notes to self before writing the real thing.\",\n        topic=\"general\", author_id=staff.id,\n    )\n    models.deactivate_user(staff.id)\n\n    print(\"Seeded a deactivated Ambassador (draft deleted by the cascade) and \"\n          \"a deactivated Staff member (draft left in place).\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Dana Whitfield\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Jordan Avery\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    _seed_deactivated_users_with_drafts(programs)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","numLines":386,"startLine":380,"totalLines":765}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b4051ea6-44fd-4c68-bad1-5ba9ca3f7c51","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

import _csrf_token_from\n7\t\n8\t\n9\tdef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n10\t    \"\"\"A valid CSRF token for an already-logged-in client, from a page that\n11\t    always renders one — unlike /admin/pages, which only embeds one inside a\n12\t    per-draft publish form.\"\"\"\n13\t    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n14\t\n15\t\n16\tdef _create_page(c, parent_id, title, \"body\": f\"Body for {title}\",\n20\t            \"csrf_token\": token}\n21\t    if show_in_footer:\n22\t        data[\"show_in_footer\"] = \"on\"\n23\t    return c.post(\"/admin/pages/new\", Jinja's\n42\t    HTML autoescaping would turn a child combinator into \"&gt;\" and silently\n43\t    drop those rules, so the preview would stop matching the exported site.\"\"\"\n44\t assert style == publish.CSS\n50\t\n51\t\n52\tdef test_exported_stylesheet_link_is_cache_busted(client, tmp_path):\n53\t    \"\"\"GitHub Pages caches style.css, so a redesign has to arrive under a their\nsupporting sections, and the demo catalog reading like real student writing.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models, publish\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _load_seed_demo():\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef _seed(client_unused=None):\n    seed_demo = _load_seed_demo()\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return seed_demo, programs\n\n\n# --- the preview and the export must agree -----------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_preview_stylesheet_is_not_html_escaped(client):\n    \"\"\"The live preview inlines the stylesheet in a <style> block. Jinja's\n    HTML autoescaping would turn a child combinator into \"&gt;\" and silently\n    drop those rules, so the preview would stop matching the exported site.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    style = client.get(\"/\").text.split(\"<style>\")[1].split(\"</style>\")[0]\n\n    assert \"&gt;\" not in style\n    assert \".prose > :first-child\" in style\n    assert style == publish.CSS\n\n\ndef test_exported_stylesheet_link_is_cache_busted(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"GitHub Pages caches style.css, so a redesign has to arrive under a new\n    URL or returning readers keep the old one.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in home\n    nested = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'href=\"../../style.css?v={publish.CSS_VERSION}\"' in nested\n    assert (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\n# --- every page type carries its supporting sections -------------------------\n\n\ndef test_home_has_a_single_column_hero_with_no_dispatch_strip(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"T11 second follow-up: dispatch strips are Program/Post-only now — the\n    Home hero lost its featured-card second column, and Home no longer lists\n    a site-wide \"Latest dispatches\" strip below it.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    home = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert \"Explore by region\" in home\n    assert \"Featured dispatch\" not in home\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in home\n\n\ndef test_continent_and_country_pages_end_after_the_child_cards(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"T11 second follow-up: no more \"recent dispatches\" strip past the\n    Country/Program cards — a Continent or Country page now ends there.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    asia = (out / \"asia\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Asia\" not in asia\n    japan = (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Recent dispatches from Japan\" not in japan\n    assert \"Programs in Japan\" in japan\n\n\ndef test_standalone_pages_render_sections_as_cards(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"About CGE and Contact Us keep a compact tinted header and move their\n    body into cards, so neither ends in an empty white page. T11 second\n    follow-up: they no longer end with a site-wide \"Latest dispatches\" strip\n    either — a standalone Page's own cards are the full extent of its body.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    about = (out / \"about-cge\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Advising\", \"Pre-departure and re-entry\", \"Student ambassadors\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in about\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in about\n\n    contact = (out / \"contact-us\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for heading in [\"Email\", \"Office\", \"Hours\"]:\n        assert f'class=\"info-card-title\">{heading}<' in contact\n    assert \"cge-demo@kenyon.edu\" in contact\n    assert \"Latest dispatches\" not in contact\n\n\ndef test_post_pages_have_an_author_row_a_back_button_and_more_from(client, tmp_path):\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    post_dir = out / \"africa\" / \"kenya\" / \"nairobi-fieldwork\"\n    post = (post_dir / \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n    assert 'class=\"byline-name\"' in post\n    assert \"Ambassador &middot; Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post or \"Ambassador · Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert 'class=\"btn\"' in post and \"Back to Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n    assert \"More from Nairobi Fieldwork\" in post\n\n\ndef test_every_public_page_puts_its_breadcrumb_trail_above_the_title(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Except Home, which has nowhere to go up to.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' not in (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    for path in [\n        (\"asia\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"asia\", \"japan\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"about-cge\", \"index.html\"),\n        (\"africa\", \"kenya\", \"nairobi-fieldwork\", \"fieldwork-notes-are-not-essays\",\n         \"index.html\"),\n    ]:\n        html = out.joinpath(*path).read_text()\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb\"' in html, path\n        assert 'class=\"breadcrumb-current\"' in html, path\n\n\n# --- the demo catalog --------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_public_bylines_never_show_a_demo_account_label(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Seeded accounts are named like students, because their names are the\n    bylines readers see.\"\"\"\n    _seed()\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n\n    for html_file in out.rglob(\"index.html\"):\n        text = html_file.read_text()\n        assert \"Ambassador Demo\" not in text, html_file\n        assert \"Staff Demo\" not in text, html_file\n\n    assert \"Maya Chen\" in (out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\" / app.services import review_gate\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\nSTATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nACTIONS = [\"submit\", \"publish\", \"bounce\", \"unpublish\"]\n\n# Every (status, action, role, is_author) -> expected target status, or None\n# if the transition must be rejected. This is every cell of the spec's table,\n# including every disallowed combination.\nCASES: list[tuple[str, str, str, bool, str | None]] = [\n    # draft --submit--> pending: the Post's own author, any role.\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", False, None),  # another Ambassador's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", False, None),  # admin isn't the author\n    # draft --publish (self-publish)--> published: admin, own Post only.\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, None),  # someone else's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),  # editor can never publish\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --publish--> published: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --bounce--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # published --unpublish--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # No other (status, action) pair exists at all.\n    (\"draft\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"draft\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, expected is None:\n        with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n            review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n    else:\n        assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, test_available_actions_matches_transition_table(status, role, is_author):\n    \"\"\"available_actions() must agree with transition() for every action,\n    not just the ones CASES happens to spell {"parentUuid":"28c598c2-cb39-4dea-b1bb-c3ad93985f5d","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"33a91965-4c86-4d20-b167-647124b02cd2","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01F339dDKnscddFBb8HHysxy","type":"tool_result","content":"79c572a Fix admin console stylesheet; style the full admin shell\nbf13007 T03: Posts — draft authoring, Topic, and a Markdown preview\n---\ncommit 79c572ab47d39fbdccd1ad2c532aa6e20916c720\nAuthor: Adam Leider <adamleidercollege@gmail.com>\nDate:   Tue Oct 6 21:30:48 2026 -0400\n\n    Fix admin console stylesheet; style the full admin shell\n    \n    The admin console rendered completely unstyled: templates/base.html linked\n    a relative \"style.css\" href that no route ever populated correctly, so it\n    404'd at every depth below the server root (#13).\n    \n    app/services/css_path.py computes the right \"../\" depth back to a new\n    GET /style.css route (app/routes/console.py), serving a new ADMIN_CSS\n    constant (app/services/console_shell.py) that reuses the public site's\n    Kenyon purple/gold + Fraunces/Inter language for a sidebar, forms, lists\n    standing in for tables, flash banners, and a destructive delete button.\n    console_shell.console_context() bundles the csrf token, stylesheet path,\n    and a role-appropriate sidebar for every authenticated route; every\n    mutating POST now redirects through redirect_with_flash() for a one-time\n    success message.\n    \n    accounts/posts/pages' list, form, and delete templates now extend\n    admin/console_base.html instead of base.html directly, so they pick up the\n    persistent sidebar that only the dashboard/content-list/metrics screens had\n    before. login.html, hello.html, and the test-only stub.html keep extending\n    base.html directly (no sidebar, pre-login/test-only).\n    \n    Review findings posted on #13.\n    \n    Closes #13\n    \n---issue13 close---\n{\"closedAt\":\"2026-10-07T01:30:50Z\",\"comments\":[\"## Fix: admin console stylesheet + full shell\\n\\n**Root cause**, confirmed: `templates/base.html` (shared by every `templates/admin/*.html`) linked `href=\\\"{{ css_path | default('style.css') }}\\\"`, and no admin route ever passed `css_path`, so it always fell back to the literal relative string `\\\"style.css\\\"` — resolved against whatever depth the current page happens to be at, so it 404s everywhere except exactly at the server root.\\n\\n### Fix\\n- `app/services/css_path.py`: `css_path_for(request)` computes the right number of `\\\"../\\\"` from the request's own URL depth back to one fixed route.\\n- `app/routes/console.py`: new `GET /style.css`, serving a new `ADMIN_CSS` constant (`app/services/console_shell.py`) as `text/css` — the stylesheet link in every template stays relative (`href=\\\"{{ css_path }}\\\"`), never root-absolute, so `scripts/check_submission.py`'s template-wide grep for `href=\\\"/` stays clean.\\n- `app/services/console_shell.py`'s `console_context(request, user, sidebar=None)` bundles csrf token + css path + a role-appropriate sidebar (Staff: full admin nav; Ambassador: \\\"My posts\\\" only) for every authenticated route, plus `redirect_with_flash(url, message)` — a 303 redirect carrying a one-time success message, rendered from `request.query_params` in `templates/base.html` with normal Jinja autoescaping (no `| safe`).\\n- Every route in `app/routes/{auth,accounts,pages,posts,console}.py` now supplies `css_path` (pre-login) or full `console_context` (authenticated), and every successful mutating POST redirects through `redirect_with_flash`.\\n- `accounts_list/edit/form.html`, `posts_list/form/delete.html`, `pages_list/form/delete.html` now extend `admin/console_base.html` (picking up the persistent sidebar that only the \\\"console\\\" screens had before) instead of `base.html` directly. `login.html`, `hello.html`, and the test-only `stub.html` deliberately keep extending `base.html` directly — no sidebar, pre-login/test-only.\\n- Delete confirmations (`posts_delete.html`, `pages_delete.html`) get `class=\\\"btn-danger\\\"`. The recursive page tree (`pages_list.html`) gets `class=\\\"page-tree\\\"` so nested levels indent instead of boxing like flat rows.\\n- `ADMIN_CSS` reuses the public site's Kenyon purple/gold palette and Fraunces/Inter fonts, with its own components (sidebar, plain-list \\\"tables\\\", forms, flash/alert banners) since the admin HTML is different enough from the public site's to risk rule collisions if they shared one stylesheet.\\n\\nA circular-import note: `console_shell.py` needs `ensure_csrf_token` from `app/routes/auth.py`, so `auth.py` imports `css_path_for` from the separate `app/services/css_path.py` instead of from `console_shell` — otherwise `auth.py` → `console_shell.py` → `auth.py` would cycle.\\n\\n### Review (fresh foreground subagent)\\nNo blocking findings. Confirmed: `css_path_for`'s depth math is correct at every route depth tried (`/login`, `/admin`, `/admin/accounts`, `/admin/posts/{id}/edit`, `/admin/pages/{id}/edit`); no root-absolute `href`/`src` introduced anywhere in `templates/`; every `TemplateResponse(request, \\\"admin/...\\\")` call site across all 5 route modules supplies the stylesheet path; every admin `\\u003cform\\u003e` still carries its csrf token; `redirect_with_flash` URL-encodes safely and handles a redirect URL that already has a query string; the Ambassador-vs-Staff sidebar default works correctly on the templates both roles share (`posts_form.html`/`posts_list.html`). One nit: my own ticket comment said `/admin/pages/{id}/edit` was \\\"depth 2\\\" — it's actually depth 3, same shape as the posts route; harmless, since `css_path_for` computes depth from the live request path, not a hardcoded table. Added one more direct test (`test_stylesheet_resolved_from_a_nested_admin_page_returns_200`) that follows a nested page's own `\\u003clink\\u003e` href and asserts 200, for a literal match to the acceptance criteria's wording, on top of the review's suggestion.\\n\\n### Verification\\n`uv run pytest -q` → 171 passed. `uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 1` → 11/12 (the pre-existing \\\"no secrets in history\\\" failure is unrelated, out of scope). Retook all 12 required screenshots (`docs/screenshots/`) with the admin console now fully styled — sidebar, forms, lists, flash messages, destructive delete button — and confirmed each one visually at 1280 and 390 (sidebar stacks cleanly at 390, no horizontal scroll).\\n\"],\"state\":\"CLOSED\"}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"9060240c-5d44-433e-8257-00d55e555bc9","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:48:36.440Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"79c572a Fix admin console stylesheet;
