(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"8651efaf-a022-41dc-aec6-860b6b8eb572","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:49:04.687Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","oldString":"**Status** (of a Post):","newString":"**Tag**:\nA Staff-curated label an Ambassador or Staff member attaches to their own\nPost from an existing list — unlike Topic, a Post can carry any number of\nTags, and nobody chooses one that doesn't already exist. Tags live\nindependently of Topic: a Post keeps exactly one Topic (its forum section)\nand zero or more Tags (free-form, cross-cutting labels like visa or\nhomestay) at the same time. Staff alone create, rename, and delete Tags,\nfrom a Tags screen in the Staff sidebar; an Ambassador picks only from what's\nalready there. Shown on a Post's card and its own page, and usable as a\nsecond, independent filter alongside Topic on a Program page — there is no\nsitewide tag listing.\n_Avoid_: calling a Tag a Topic or treating it as a replacement for Topic —\nthe two coexist: Topic is single-select and fixed to six values; Tag is\nmulti-select and Staff-extensible.\n\n**Status** (of a Post):","originalFile":"# Kenyon CGE Study Abroad CMS\n\nGlossary for the CMS built for the Kenyon Center for Global Engagement's study\nabroad blog. Client: `notes/client-brief.md`. The 7 fixed capabilities this\nvocabulary has to satisfy: `docs/manual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md` §3.3.\n\n## Language\n\n**Page**:\nSite content with a parent — except Home, which has none. Most Pages sit in\nthe Continent → Country → Program tree below Home, but a Page can also stand\nalone under Home directly, like About CGE or Contact Us. Home's own body\nlists the Continents, full stop — standalone Pages under Home don't appear\nthere. Every other Page's body lists its non-footer child Pages, if it has\nany, and its own Posts grouped by Topic, if it has any — no separate\ntemplate per level otherwise. A reader finds a Page three ways: the top nav\nbar (Home plus the Continents, always, regardless of what else exists), a\nbreadcrumb trail built from its parent chain (e.g. Home → Asia → Japan →\nKenyon-in-Kyoto), and the footer, which lists any Page with its \"show in\nfooter\" flag checked — a standalone Page under Home is only reachable this\nway, so it's expected to always have that flag checked. Staff add more\nContinents, Countries, Programs, and standalone Pages later through the\nnormal page editor, the same way the seed set was created.\n_Avoid_: continent page, country page, program page as if they were distinct\ntypes — they are all just Pages at different places in the tree. Also avoid\nassuming every Page is travel content — About CGE and Contact Us are Pages\ntoo, just standalone ones under Home.\n\n**Continent**:\nA Page one level below Home — Asia, Africa, and Europe in the seed data. Lists\nits child Country Pages.\n\n**Country**:\nA Page one level below a Continent. Lists its child Program Pages.\n\n**Program**:\nA Page one level below a Country — the level Posts are written under. Lists\nits own Posts, grouped by Topic, with a filter by Topic.\n\n**Post**:\nA dated blog entry written under a Program Page: title, slug, Markdown body,\nTopic, author, timestamps, and a status of draft, pending, or published.\n_Avoid_: entry, article.\n\n**Slug**:\nThe URL-safe name derived from a Post's or Page's title. Nobody edits it by\nhand — it regenerates automatically whenever the title changes while the\ncontent is still draft, then freezes the moment it's published, so a shared\nlink never breaks. Shown read-only wherever the content is edited.\n_Avoid_: implying it's a form field a Staff or Ambassador fills in — it has\nno input of its own, only a display.\n\n**Topic**:\nThe category a Post is tagged with, used to group and filter Posts on their\nProgram page like forum sections (read-only — no replies or discussion):\nGeneral, Housing, Meals, Social Life, Academics, or Other.\n_Avoid_: treating General as a different kind of thing from the rest — see\nHot Topic for how the two relate.\n\n**Hot Topic**:\nAny Topic value other than General — Housing, Meals, Social Life, Academics,\nor Other. The brief and field notes' informal name for that subset; there is\nno separate field for it, only Topic.\n_Avoid_: treating Hot Topic as a type distinct from Topic, or as a field of\nits own — see Topic.\n\n**Status** (of a Post):\ndraft → pending → published. *Draft*: the author is still writing; only they\ncan edit it, and it is not public. *Pending*: the author has submitted it for\nreview and can no longer edit it; it is still not public — anyone with the\nadmin role can act on it, not just a specific reviewer, and there is no\nnotification when a Post lands in the queue. *Published*: live on the public\nsite. Only an admin can move a Post into or out of published, and only an\nadmin can bounce pending back to draft. One shortcut: an admin can publish\ntheir own draft directly, skipping pending, since there is no one else to\nreview it against; an admin's draft can also go through pending like anyone\nelse's if they want another admin's eyes on it first. The shortcut applies\nonly to an admin's own Post — an admin cannot push someone else's draft\nstraight to published without it passing through pending. If the author's\naccount is later deactivated, what happens to a draft depends on their role:\nan Ambassador's draft is deleted (nothing worth keeping from a student who's\nleft, and it would otherwise clutter the content list); a Staff member's\ndraft is left exactly as it is — it's usually CGE's own ongoing work, not a\ndeparting student's, and any other Staff member can already view, edit,\npublish, or delete it like any other Post. Either way, a pending Post is\nleft alone, since Staff still need to act on it, and a published Post is\nleft alone too and keeps its byline, since its value to readers has nothing\nto do with whether its author's account is still active.\n_Avoid_: treating pending as a synonym for draft — the manual's capability list\nnames only draft/published, but this project adds pending as the explicit\nsubmit-for-review step the client asked for (see ADR-004).\n\n**Role**:\nTwo roles, per the manual: *admin*, shown in the UI as **Staff**, and *editor*,\nshown in the UI as **Ambassador**. The mapping is strict and permission-based,\nnot title-based — admin/editor stay the internal/code names (the manual's own\nvocabulary); Staff/Ambassador are what the site and this glossary call them.\nStaff have every capability Ambassadors have (they can write and submit Posts\ntoo) plus admin-only capabilities (publish, user management).\n_Avoid_: \"CGE staff\" / \"student ambassador\" in place of Staff/Ambassador once\ninside the CMS's own vocabulary — those are brief language, not the product's.\n\n**Staff**:\nThe UI-facing name for the admin role (see Role). Can manage users; create,\nedit, delete, and publish any Page or Post; and do everything an Ambassador\ncan, including writing and submitting their own Posts — with the option to\neither self-publish a draft directly or submit it to pending like anyone\nelse (see Status).\n_Avoid_: \"CGE staff\", admin — see Role.\n\n**Ambassador**:\nThe UI-facing name for the editor role (see Role): a student who writes and\nsubmits their own Posts. Can create, edit, and delete only their own Posts,\nand only while draft (see Status); cannot touch another user's Post, cannot\ncreate or edit a Page, and cannot publish.\n_Avoid_: \"student ambassador\", editor — see Role.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":64,"oldLines":6,"newStart":64,"newLines":21,"lines":[" _Avoid_: treating Hot Topic as a type distinct from Topic, or as a field of"," its own — see Topic."," ","+**Tag**:","+A Staff-curated label an Ambassador or Staff member attaches to their own","+Post from an existing list — unlike Topic, a Post can carry any number of","+Tags, and nobody chooses one that doesn't already exist. Tags live","+independently of Topic: a Post keeps exactly one Topic (its forum section)","+and zero or more Tags (free-form, cross-cutting labels like visa or","+homestay) at the same time. Staff alone create, rename, and delete Tags,","+from a Tags screen in the Staff sidebar; an Ambassador picks only from what's","+already there. Shown on a Post's card and its own page, and usable as a","+second, independent filter alongside Topic on a Program page — there is no","+sitewide tag listing.","+_Avoid_: calling a Tag a Topic or treating it as a replacement for Topic —","+the two coexist: Topic is single-select and fixed to six values; Tag is","+multi-select and Staff-extensible.","+"," **Status** (of a Post):"," draft → pending → published. *Draft*: the author is still writing; only they"," can edit it, and it is not public. *Pending*: the author has submitted it for"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e5869d93-5e15-4fd0-9dcd-41270e159633","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Admin-only (require_admin, same gate as Pages and\nAccounts): only Staff create, rename, or delete a Tag here. An Ambassador\nstill picks from the existing list when writing a Post (app/routes/posts.py)\nbut never reaches a route in this module.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_admin, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/tags\")\n\nDUPLICATE_NAME_ERROR = \"A tag with that name already exists.\"\n\n\ndef _get_tag_or_404(tag_id: int) -> models.Tag:\n    tag = models.get_tag_by_id(tag_id)\n    if tag is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such tag\")\n    return tag\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request, user: models.User, tag: models.Tag | None,\n    error: str | None = None, name: str = \"\", status_code: int = 200,\n):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Rename tag\" if tag else \"New tag\",\n        \"tag\": tag,\n        \"error\": error,\n        \"form_name\": name,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/tags_form.html\", context, status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_tags(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Tags\", \"tags\": models.list_tags()})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/tags_list.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_tag_form(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return _render_form(request, user, tag=None)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_tag(\n    request: Request,\n    name: str = Form(\"\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    name = name.strip()\n    if not name:\n        return _render_form(request, user, tag=None, error=\"Name is required.\",\n                             name=name, status_code=400)\n    try:\n        models.create_tag(name)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return _render_form(request, user, tag=None, error=DUPLICATE_NAME_ERROR,\n                             name=name, status_code=400)\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\"/admin/tags\", \"Tag created.\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{tag_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_tag_form(\n    request: Request, tag_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    tag = _get_tag_or_404(tag_id)\n    return _render_form(request, user, tag=tag, name=tag.name)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{tag_id}/edit\")\nasync def rename_tag(\n    request: Request,\n    tag_id: int,\n    name: str = Form(\"\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    tag = _get_tag_or_404(tag_id)\n    name = name.strip()\n    if not name:\n        return _render_form(request, user, tag=tag, error=\"Name is required.\",\n                             name=name, status_code=400)\n    try:\n        models.rename_tag(tag_id, name)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return _render_form(request, user, tag=tag, error=DUPLICATE_NAME_ERROR,\n                             name=name, status_code=400)\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\"/admin/tags\", \"Tag renamed.\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{tag_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_tag(\n    request: Request, tag_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)\n):\n    tag = _get_tag_or_404(tag_id)\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\"title\": \"Delete tag?\", \"tag\": tag})\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/tags_delete.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{tag_id}/delete\")\nasync def delete_tag(\n    tag_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_tag_or_404(tag_id)\n    models.delete_tag(tag_id)\n    return console_shell.redirect_with_flash(\"/admin/tags\", \"Tag Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, posts, public\nfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, CsrfInvalid, LoginRequired\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n\n    # {"parentUuid":"97203ef5-079e-46ea-86d3-4acf8ad4b2c1","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"33a91965-4c86-4d20-b167-647124b02cd2","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01QVQmpG4kZuJfDwKEQ1qZuB","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/console_shell.py has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"97e1b48a-cc2a-470b-aa97-210390ed32cd","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:49:48.625Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/console_shell.py","oldString":"    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]","newString":"    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/tags\", \"Tags\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]","originalFile":"\"\"\"Shared chrome for every server-rendered admin screen: the sidebar nav,\nthe relative stylesheet link, and post-save flash messages. Every\n`app/routes/*.py` module except `public.py` uses this (the public site has\nits own, unrelated live-preview chrome in `app/routes/public.py`).\n\nIssue #13: the admin console's stylesheet link is relative and\ndepth-computed (see app.services.css_path) rather than root-absolute —\na literal `href=\"/...\"` would still work on this live server, but\n`scripts/check_submission.py` greps every tracked template for\nroot-absolute paths regardless of whether the page is ever statically\nexported, so this stays relative like everything else.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token\nfrom app.services.css_path import css_path_for\n\nSIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin/dashboard\", \"Dashboard\"),\n    (\"/admin/content\", \"Content list\"),\n    (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),\n    (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),\n    (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),\n    (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),\n]\n\nEDITOR_SIDEBAR = [\n    (\"/admin\", \"My posts\"),\n]\n\n\ndef console_context(request: Request, user: models.User, sidebar=None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The csrf token, stylesheet path, and sidebar every authenticated\n    admin screen needs. Defaults the sidebar by role (Staff vs Ambassador)\n    so most call sites don't have to pick one themselves.\"\"\"\n    chosen = sidebar or (SIDEBAR if user.role == \"admin\" else EDITOR_SIDEBAR)\n    return {\n        \"user\": user,\n        \"csrf_token\": ensure_csrf_token(request),\n        \"css_path\": css_path_for(request),\n        \"sidebar\": [{\"href\": href, \"label\": label} for href, label in chosen],\n    }\n\n\ndef redirect_with_flash(url: str, message: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    \"\"\"A 303 redirect carrying a one-time success message, read back by\n    templates/base.html's `request.query_params`. No session state: a\n    refresh of the destination page just drops the message, which is fine\n    for a \"your save worked\" banner.\"\"\"\n    sep = \"&\" if \"?\" in url else \"?\"\n    return RedirectResponse(url=f\"{url}{sep}flash={quote(message)}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# Reuses the public site's Kenyon purple + gold palette and Fraunces/Inter\n# fonts (app/publish.py's CSS) for a consistent look, but is otherwise\n# self-contained: the admin console's HTML (sidebar, forms, plain <ul> lists\n# standing in for tables) is different enough from the public site's that\n# sharing one stylesheet would mean every admin rule risks colliding with a\n# public one, or vice versa.\nADMIN_CSS = \"\"\"/* Admin console shell — issue #13. Same palette/fonts as the\n   public site (app/publish.py's CSS), different components: a sidebar\n   layout, plain lists standing in for tables, and HTML forms. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --gold: #C98A3B;\n  --gold-dark: #9C6723;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --muted: #5a5064;\n  --border: #E4DCEC;\n  --paper: #FDFBFE;\n  --panel: #FFFFFF;\n  --danger: #B3261E;\n  --danger-dark: #8C1D16;\n  --danger-bg: #FBE9E4;\n  --success-bg: #E3F3EF;\n  --success-border: #2E7D6B;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.6 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-wrap: anywhere;\n}\nh1, h2 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 1rem; }\nh2 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin-top: 2rem; }\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }\n\nheader.site-header {\n  background: var(--purple);\n  padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem;\n}\nheader.site-header .brand {\n  color: #fff;\n  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 1.1rem;\n}\nmain { padding: 1.5rem; max-width: 68rem; margin: 0 auto; }\nfooter { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }\n\n.flash {\n  background: var(--success-bg);\n  border: 1px solid var(--success-border);\n  color: #1c4038;\n  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n[role=\"alert\"] {\n  background: var(--danger-bg);\n  border: 1px solid var(--danger);\n  color: var(--danger-dark);\n  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* -- forms ------------------------------------------------------------- */\nform { margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }\nlabel { display: block; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); }\ninput[type=\"text\"], input[type=\"email\"], input[type=\"password\"], select, textarea {\n  display: block;\n  margin-top: 0.3rem;\n  width: 100%;\n  max-width: 32rem;\n  font: inherit;\n  padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.4rem;\n  background: #fff;\n  color: var(--ink);\n}\ninput[type=\"checkbox\"] { width: auto; display: inline-block; margin-right: 0.4rem; }\ntextarea { min-height: 9rem; font-family: ui-monospace, \"SFMono-Regular\", monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; }\ninput:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--purple); }\n\nbutton, .btn {\n  font: inherit;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;\n  background: var(--purple);\n  color: #fff;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  display: inline-block;\n}\nbutton:hover, .btn:hover { background: var(--purple-dark); }\nbutton.btn-danger { background: var(--danger); }\nbutton.btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-dark); }\n\n.post-preview, .preview-pane {\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;\n  background: #fff;\n  max-width: 40rem;\n}\n\n/* -- lists standing in for tables --------------------------------------- */\nul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }\nmain ul li {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;\n  background: #fff;\n}\nmain ul li form { margin: 0; }\n\n/* The Page hierarchy tree nests arbitrarily deep — indent it instead of\n   boxing every level like a flat row list. */\n.page-tree, .page-tree ul { padding-left: 0; }\n.page-tree li, .page-tree li li {\n  display: block;\n  border: none;\n  background: none;\n  padding: 0.3rem 0 0.3rem 0.9rem;\n  margin: 0;\n  border-left: 2px solid var(--border);\n}\n\n/* -- the Staff/Ambassador console shell --------------------------------- */\n.console { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0; }\n.console-sidebar {\n  flex: 0 0 15rem;\n  background: var(--purple-light);\n  border-radius: 0.6rem;\n  padding: 1.1rem;\n  margin-right: 1.75rem;\n}\n.console-sidebar p { margin: 0 0 0.6rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); }\n.console-sidebar nav ul { margin-top: 0.75rem; }\n.console-sidebar nav li {\n  display: block; border: none; background: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 0.25rem;\n}\n.console-sidebar nav a {\n  display: block;\n  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;\n  border-radius: 0.4rem;\n  color: var(--purple-dark);\n  font-weight: 600;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.console-sidebar nav a:hover { background: #fff; }\n.console-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }\n\n@media (max-width: 30rem) {\n  main { padding: 1rem; }\n  .console { flex-direction: column; }\n  .console-sidebar { flex: none; width: 100%; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; }\n  input[type=\"text\"], input[type=\"email\"], input[type=\"password\"], select, textarea,\n  .post-preview, .preview-pane { max-width: none; }\n}\n\"\"\"\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":27,"oldLines":6,"newStart":27,"newLines":7,"lines":["     (\"/admin/pending\", \"Pending queue\"),","     (\"/admin/accounts\", \"Accounts\"),","     (\"/admin/pages\", \"Page hierarchy\"),","+    (\"/admin/tags\", \"Tags\"),","     (\"/admin/metrics\", \"Metrics\"),"," ]"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"97203ef5-079e-46ea-86d3-4acf8ad4b2c1","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

\"admin/posts_form.html\", context)","originalFile":"\"\"\"Post authoring: draft CRUD, Topic, a sanitized Markdown preview, and the\nADR-004 review-gate state machine (T04, #5).\n\nUnlike Pages (admin-only), Post authoring is open to any active user\n(require_user), with ownership enforced inside the route: an Ambassador\n(editor) may only touch their own Post, and only while it is draft; a Staff\nmember (admin) may touch any Post, same as Pages. The submit/publish/bounce/\nunpublish transitions delegate every allow/deny decision to\napp.services.review_gate, so this module just resolves the Post, asks the\nservice whether the action is allowed, and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import require_user, verify_csrf\nfrom app.services import console_shell, markdown, review_gate\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\")\n\n\ndef _get_program_or_404(program_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    \"\"\"Resolve program_id, rejecting up front if it isn't a Program-level\n    Page — otherwise a user could fill out the whole new-post form before\n    hitting the same rejection as a save-time error (models.create_post\n    still checks this too, as the model layer's own guarantee).\"\"\"\n    program = models.get_page_by_id(program_id)\n    if program is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such program page\")\n    if not models.is_program_page(program):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Not a Program-level page\")\n    return program\n\n\ndef _get_post_or_404(post_id: int) -> models.Post:\n    post = models.get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef _authorize_post_write(user: models.User, post: models.Post) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Admin: any Post, any status. Editor: only their own, only while draft.\"\"\"\n    if user.role == \"admin\":\n        return\n    if post.author_id != user.id or post.status != \"draft\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Forbidden\")\n\n\ndef _apply_transition(user: models.User, post: models.Post, action: str) -> models.Post:\n    \"\"\"Ask review_gate whether `action` is allowed, then persist its answer.\n\n    review_gate.transition raises ValueError -> 403 (not allowed at all).\n    models.set_post_status raises StatusConflict -> 409 (it *was* allowed\n    against the status we read, but another request changed it first).\n    \"\"\"\n    is_author = post.author_id == user.id\n    try:\n        new_status = review_gate.transition(post.status, action, user.role, is_author)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))\n    try:\n        return models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=new_status)\n    except models.StatusConflict as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc))\n\n\ndef _render_form(\n    request: Request,\n    user: models.User,\n    post: models.Post | None,\n    program: models.Page,\n    error: str | None = None,\n    title: str = \"\",\n    body: str = \"\",\n    topic: str = \"general\",\n):\n    context = console_shell.console_context(request, user)\n    context.update({\n        \"title\": \"Edit post\" if post else \"New post\",\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"program\": program,\n        \"error\": error,\n        \"form_title\": title,\n        \"form_body\": body,\n        \"form_topic\": topic,\n        \"preview_html\": markdown.render(body),\n        \"topics\": models.TOPIC_CHOICES,\n    })\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/posts_form.html\", context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_posts(\n    request: Request, program_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_user)\n):\n    program = _get_program_or_404(program_id)\n    posts = models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    if user.role != \"admin\":\n        posts = [p for p in posts if p.author_id == user.id]\n    posts_with_actions = [\n        (\n            post,\n            [\n                (action, review_gate.ACTION_LABELS[action])\n                for action in A Tag nobody on\n    this Program has used yet is left out, same as `group_posts_by_topic`\n    omits an empty Topic.\"\"\"\n    seen: dict[int, models.Tag] = {}\n    for _value, _label, summaries in post_groups:\n        for summary in summaries:\n            for tag in summary[\"tags\"]:\n                seen[tag.id] = tag\n    return sorted(seen.values(), key=lambda t: t.name)","originalFile":"\"\"\"Turn published Posts into template-ready summaries, grouped by Topic.\n\nShared by app/publish.py (static export) and app/routes/public.py (live\npreview) so the two keep rendering the same grouping, byline, and date for\nthe same data — same reason they already share app/models.py's queries and\napp/services/markdown.render.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\nTOPIC_LABELS = dict(models.TOPIC_CHOICES)\n\n# How many distinct region accent colors app/publish.py's CSS defines\n# (.region-0 .. .region-5) — cycles if Staff add a 7th Continent.\nREGION_COUNT = 6\n\n\n# The UI-facing name for each role, per CONTEXT.md's Role entry: admin shows\n# as Staff, editor as Ambassador.\nROLE_LABELS = {\"admin\": \"Staff\", \"editor\": \"Ambassador\"}\n\n_MONTHS = [\"January\", \"February\", \"March\", \"April\", \"May\", \"June\", \"July\",\n           \"August\", \"September\", \"October\", \"November\", \"December\"]\n\n\ndef _author(post: models.Post) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"-> (display name, UI role label) for a Post's byline.\"\"\"\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n    if user is None:\n        return \"CGE Staff\", ROLE_LABELS[\"admin\"]\n    return user.display_name, ROLE_LABELS.get(user.role, ROLE_LABELS[\"editor\"])\n\n\ndef _published_date(post: models.Post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"ISO stamp -> \"6 October 2026\". Falls back to the raw date if the stamp\n    isn't the shape SQLite writes.\"\"\"\n    stamp = (post.published_at or post.created_at or \"\")[:10]\n    try:\n        year, month, day = (int(part) for part in stamp.split(\"-\"))\n        return f\"{day} {_MONTHS[month - 1]} {year}\"\n    except (ValueError, IndexError):\n        return stamp\n\n\ndef _initials(name: str) -> str:\n    letters = \"\".join(part[0] for part in name.split()[:2])\n    return letters.upper() or \"?\"\n\n\ndef post_summary(post: models.Post, href: str) -> dict:\n    author_name, author_role = _author(post)\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"href\": href,\n        \"title\": post.title,\n        \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(post.body),\n        \"topic_value\": post.topic,\n        \"topic_label\": TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic],\n        \"author_name\": author_name,\n        \"author_role\": author_role,\n        \"author_initials\": _initials(author_name),\n        \"published_date\": _published_date(post),\n    }\n\n\ndef children_heading(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"What to call a Page's list of child Pages, in the reader's words\n    rather than the tree's: Home browses regions, a Continent lists its\n    Countries, a Country lists its Programs.\"\"\"\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"Explore by region\"\n    if models.is_continent_page(page):\n        return f\"Countries in {page.title}\"\n    if models.is_country_page(page):\n        return f\"Programs in {page.title}\"\n    return \"Pages\"\n\n\ndef region_index(page: models.Page, home: models.Page, continents: list[models.Page]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Which Continent's accent color governs `page` — None for Home itself,\n    otherwise the index (mod REGION_COUNT) of the Continent that page lives\n    under (or, if `page` is itself a Continent, its own index). Shared by\n    every card and page-header band so a Continent's whole subtree (its\n    Country and Program pages too) reads in one consistent accent color.\"\"\"\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return None\n    root_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n    for i, continent in enumerate(continents):\n        if continent.id == root_id:\n            return i % REGION_COUNT\n    return None\n\n\ndef program_stats(program_id: int) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Published-post count and the distinct Topic labels present, for a\n    Program's card on its parent Country's listing.\"\"\"\n    posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    topics: list[str] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    for post in posts:\n        if post.topic not in seen:\n            seen.add(post.topic)\n            topics.append(TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic])\n    return {\"post_count\": len(posts), \"topics\": topics}\n\n\ndef page_card(\n    page: models.Page,\n    href: str,\n    home: models.Page,\n    continents: list[models.Page],\n    stats: dict | None = None,\n) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"A Continent/Country/Program's card on its parent's listing: title,\n    href, a short description teased from the Page's own body, its region\n    accent, and — for a Program card — its post count and Topics.\"\"\"\n    return {\n        \"title\": page.title,\n        \"href\": href,\n        \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(page.body),\n        \"region\": region_index(page, home, continents),\n        \"post_count\": stats[\"post_count\"] if stats else None,\n        \"topics\": stats[\"topics\"] if stats else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef grouped_post_summaries(\n    posts: list[models.Post], href_for: Callable[[models.Post], str]\n) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]:\n    \"\"\"-> [(topic_value, topic_label, [post_summary, ...]), ...], Topics with\n    no published Posts omitted.\"\"\"\n    groups = models.group_posts_by_topic(posts)\n    return [\n        (value, label, [post_summary(post, href_for(post)) for post in group_posts])\n        for value, label, group_posts in groups\n    ]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":60,"oldLines":6,"newStart":60,"newLines":7,"lines":["         \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(post.body),","         \"topic_value\": post.topic,","         \"topic_label\": TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic],","+        \"tags\": models.get_tags_for_post(post.id),","         \"author_name\": author_name,","         \"author_role\": author_role,","         \"author_initials\": _initials(author_name),"]},{"oldStart":67,"oldLines":6,"newStart":68,"newLines":19,"lines":["     }"," "," ","+def distinct_tags(post_groups: list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]) -> list[models.Tag]:","+    \"\"\"Every Tag actually used by a Program's currently-shown Posts, in name","+    order — the options for its reader-facing Tag filter. It and\nthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\napp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n\nOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef resolve(path: str) -> tuple[str, models.Page] | tuple[str, models.Post, models.Page] | None:\n    \"\"\"A Page by its full path, or — one segment further, under a Program —\n    a published Post by slug. Returns None on no match.\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n    current = home\n    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):\n        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n        if child is not None:\n            current = child\n            continue\n        if i == len(segments) - 1 and models.is_program_page(current):\n            post = models.get_published_post_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n            if post is not None:\n                return \"post\", post, current\n        return None\n    return \"page\", current\n\n\ndef _path_for(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"/\"\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(page) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(page.slug)\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n\n\ndef page_context(page: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != page.id]\n    children = models.list_published_children(page.id)\n    active_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n    is_country = models.is_country_page(page)\n\n    post_groups = None\n    if models.is_program_page(page):\n        page_href = _path_for(page, home)\n        posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n        post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n            posts, lambda post: page_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n        )\n\n    intro_md, rest_md = markdown.split_intro(page.body)\n    sections = []\n    if models.is_standalone_page(page):\n        sections = [\n            {\"heading\": heading, \"body_html\": markdown.render(body)}\n            for heading, body in markdown.split_sections(rest_md)\n        ]\n        rest_md = markdown.strip_sections(rest_md)\n\n    return {\n        \"page\": page,\n        \"intro_html\": markdown.render(intro_md),\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(rest_md),\n        \"sections\": sections,\n        \"region\": post_view.region_index(page, home, continents),\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\", \"active\": active_id == home.id}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home), \"active\": active_id == c.id}\n            for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n        \"children\": [\n            post_view.page_card(\n                c, _path_for(c, home), home, continents,\n                stats=post_view.program_stats(c.id) if is_country else None,\n            )\n            for c in children\n        ],\n        \"children_heading\": post_view.children_heading(page, home),\n        \"post_groups\": post_groups,\n    }\n\n\ndef post_context(post: models.Post, program: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(program) if a.id != program.id]\n    program_href = _path_for(program, home)\n    post_href = program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n    summary = post_view.post_summary(post, post_href)\n    active_id = models.nav_root_id(program, home)\n    more_from = [\n        post_view.post_summary(other, program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{other.slug}/\")\n        for other in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n        if other.id != post.id\n    ][:2]\n\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(post.body),\n        \"topic_label\": summary[\"topic_label\"],\n        \"author_name\": summary[\"author_name\"],\n        \"author_role\": summary[\"author_role\"],\n        \"author_initials\": summary[\"author_initials\"],\n        \"published_date\": summary[\"published_date\"],\n        \"region\": post_view.region_index(program, home, continents),\n        \"more_from\": more_from,\n        \"program_href\": program_href,\n        \"program_title\": program.title,\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\", \"active\": active_id == home.id}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home), \"active\": active_id == c.id}\n            for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors]\n        + [{\"title\": program.title, \"href\": program_href}],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{path:path}\")\ndef public_page(request: Request, path: str):\n    resolved = resolve(path)\n    if resolved is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    if resolved[0] == \"post\":\n        _kind, post, program = resolved\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/post.html\",\n            {\"title\": post.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, **post_context(post, program)},\n        )\n\n    _kind, page = resolved\n    if page.status != \"published\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"public/page.html\",\n        {\"title\": page.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, **page_context(page)},\n    )\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":58,"oldLines":12,"newStart":58,"newLines":14,"lines":["     is_country = models.is_country_page(page)"," ","     post_groups = None","+    tag_filters = None"," {"parentUuid":"d8091ba0-9c4a-43c5-8e1f-0e8abe779707","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"33a91965-4c86-4d20-b167-647124b02cd2","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019N2bUk4isZ9EHXJbcLZHCv","type":"tool_result","content":"scripts/screenshot.py\n---\n# Copy to .env (which is gitignored) and change the values.\n# .env is loaded automatically (app/env_file.py) — nothing needs sourcing it\n# into your shell first; a real exported env var still overrides it.\nCMS_SECRET_KEY=change-me-to-a-long-random-string\nCMS_SITE_TITLE=Knox County Historical Society\nCMS_DATABASE=cms.db\n# Demo accounts created by scripts/seed_demo.py\nCMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me-admin\nCMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD=change-me-editor\nCMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD=change-me-deactivated\n# Set after you deploy, e.g. https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nCMS_BASE_PATH=\n# Your name, used in docs/transcripts/ filenames by the SessionEnd hook.\nCMS_STUDENT=adam-leider\n---cli---\n\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"21b52a09-d20c-454b-856d-a4faed75ace8","timestamp":"2026-10-07T01:55:42.286Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"scripts/screenshot.py\n---\n# Copy to .env (which is gitignored) and change the values.\n# .env is loaded automatically (app/env_file.py) — nothing needs sourcing it\n# into your shell first; Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d8091ba0-9c4a-43c5-8e1f-0e8abe779707","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

A tampered or stale request (e.g. a tag deleted in another tab, then resubmitted) would hit the `post_tags.tag_id` foreign key and 500 instead of failing cleanly. Added `_existing_tag_ids()`, which drops any id that isn't a real Tag before the call. Covered by a new test, `test_a_deleted_tag_id_submitted_with_the_post_form_is_dropped_not_500`.\n- **nit (not changed)** — `app/services/post_view.py`'s `post_summary` calls `models.get_tags_for_post` once per post (an N+1 pattern), same shape as the existing per-post `get_user_by_id` call for the byline. Not a correctness bug at this project's scale; left as-is for consistency with the existing style rather than introducing a batching abstraction nothing else here uses.\n- **none found** — Permissions: every `/admin/tags/*` route is gated by `require_admin`, same as Pages/Accounts; \"Tags\" only appears in the Staff sidebar. An Ambassador can only attach *existing* tags to their own Post — no privilege escalation.\n- **none found** — Relative-paths constraint: `git grep -n 'href=\"/' -- '*.html'` and `'src=\"/'` are clean across all new/changed templates; `scripts/check_submission.py`'s check only greps those two attributes, so the new forms' `action=\"/admin/tags/...\"` (matching the existing Pages/Posts/Accounts pattern) doesn't trip it.\n- **none found** — The combined Topic+Tag filter JS in `templates/public/page.html` correctly recomputes each topic-group's visibility from its own filtered cards, so a group hides itself once its tag-filtered cards are empty.\n- **none found** — `set_post_tags` does delete-then-insert (full replace), verified by `test_editing_a_post_replaces_its_tag_set`; FastAPI's `Form(list[int])` repeated-field parsing is exercised directly by the tests, not just assumed.\n\n### Verification\n\n- `uv run pytest -q` → 185 passed (184 before the fix above, +1 new test).\n- `uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2` → \"no root-absolute paths in HTML\": clean; \"test suite passes\": clean. both Ambassadors and Staff can apply them, only Staff can create/rename/delete one.\n- Tags show on post cards and post pages (public site), plus a second \"Filter by tag\" pill row on Program pages that combines client-side with the existing Topic filter.\n- `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds 5 starter tags and applies them to the demo catalog by Topic.\n- Added `CONTEXT.md`'s Tag glossary entry.\n- 185 tests pass (13 new), independently code-reviewed (fresh foreground subagent per this repo's CLAUDE.md), one nit fixed (a stale/tampered `tag_id` now gets dropped instead of 500ing), findings posted on the issue, verified manually against the running dev server."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":201,"cache_read_input_tokens":242012,"output_tokens":390,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":201,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":390,"cache_read_input_tokens":242012,"cache_creation_input_tokens":201,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":201},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011Cfn45YETvobBQEP8Lwnqt","type":"assistant","uuid":"04ae222c-06c5-45ae-87d9-a0b4790d895d","timestamp":"2026-10-07T02:02:37.076Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3bc2f459-09bb-421f-82bc-e9594d84afff","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Fixed under its own issue, #13.\n \n ## Q3: Skills, prompts, resources\n - Skills: /grill-with-docs, /to-spec, /to-tickets, /implement, /tdd, /code-review, /setup-matt-pocock-skills\n@@ -59,6 +60,7 @@\n - A /loop wakeup kept re-firing after tickets were done, re-prompting Claude for nothing.\n - Claude committed T07 but didn't push, so issue #8 stayed open.
